headline: The striking decline in real gross wages in Italy's private sector
summary: According to OECD data, real gross wages per full-time equivalent employee in Italy's private sector fell 1.6% between 1990 and 2024, against average growth of 35% across comparable countries.
why: Real wage trends shape consumer spending power and inflation dynamics, and the OECD is a major source of cross-country economic statistics.
